description: DC blocker, short form, length 16, on complex samples with a step vs dc_blocker_cc

fixed_vs_float.rationale: Taps rounded to Q23 (sum of |tap rounding error| 0.0) acting on an input peak of 0.555 FS per component, plus 0.5 LSB of output rounding (Q15) and 0.02 Q15 LSB for the f32 reference itself; per component <= 0.52 Q15 LSB, x sqrt(2) for the complex magnitude. SNR minimum is the measured value minus 1 dB.

Taps rounded to Q23 (sum of |tap rounding error| 0.0) acting on an input peak of 0.555 FS per component, plus 1.0 LSB of output rounding (Q15) and 0.02 Q15 LSB for the f32 reference itself; per component <= 1.02 Q15 LSB, x sqrt(2) for the complex magnitude. SNR minimum is the measured value minus 1 dB.

Taps rounded to Q25 (sum of |tap rounding error| 0.0) acting on an input peak of 0.555 FS per component, plus 0.5 LSB of output rounding (Q17) and 0.02 Q15 LSB for the f32 reference itself; per component <= 0.145 Q15 LSB, x sqrt(2) for the complex magnitude. SNR minimum is the measured value minus 1 dB.

float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: f32 rounding in an 31-tap sum: each of the n additions errs by at most 2^-24 of the partial sum (<= peak * sum|taps| = 1.0406250000000001); twice that covers both evaluation orders (GNU Radio uses SIMD kernels): 0.1782 Q15 LSB. SNR minimum is the measured value minus 1 dB.
